## CONTINUATION-EVIDENCE-2026-10-26.md

# Router VPN continuation evidence — October 26, 2026

This ledger records the evidence recovered and changes delivered during the
October 26 continuation. It supplements the original requirements and
[reconciled contract](REQUIREMENTS-RECONCILED.md); it does not replace either.
Overlapping historical lists are not added into a completion percentage.

## Requirement authority and recovery limits

The user supplied the October 22 continuation handoff, the historical green
`745b3e41e5a78d734391976af9b7cd0637660a0b` release report, and a new instruction
to finish the requirements and immediately commit/push coherent finished work
to `main`. Live GitHub and the preserved workspace were instead at
`4d85fac8a207d04cd66565190ba52c118bbb99a9` when this continuation started.
The newer source was preserved; older recovery patches were not replayed over it.

Personal-context retrieval recovered indexed user passages, including the
August 11 product request and September 4 Tor bridge request. Searches for the
named original private documents did not return their full contents. In
particular, this continuation did **not** independently read all 356 original
numbered user passages, C1–C7 source messages, or the entire later 32-item
request. The repository audits provide a derived index, not a verbatim original.
An unavailable source is not evidence that its requirement was cancelled.

A later targeted retrieval also returned a user-indexed October 19 passage for
desktop packet exits, proxy entries, OpenVPN, Tor, MAX/ALL and external-node
additions. It supplied continuity evidence, not the complete original numbered
messages. A further private-file search returned no matching original files.

A targeted Tor Server/Compare request later returned "Personal context is
unavailable for this conversation"; one narrower private-file content search
also returned no original passage. The required meaning and source of a Tor
"last node response" therefore remain unresolved. The existing Tor-project
HTTP check proves a dynamic exit; it must not be counted twice or relabeled as
a response from the final relay to manufacture a comparison score.
A further self-contained context query returned "Unable to search relevant
sources". Exact and simplified private-file searches for the Router VPN,
Tor comparison, original transcript and addendum passages returned no matching
files. Those bounded access failures do not close or remove the requirement.

The supplied handoff's explicit corrections remain binding: Home AdGuard;
SMART AUTO and IPv6 On defaults; AUTO encryption/obfuscation requirements Off;
Off/AES-256-GCM/AES-256-GCM plus XOR Start Layers; comparison arithmetic mean
with the same external endpoint, invalid candidates unscored and repeat proof;
30-minute retention from READY; blank AdGuard allow-list unrestricted;
image-only exact-SHA production without Docker socket access; generic apps
separate from private linking; Windows Portable ZIP, with PAF cancelled;
client kill-switch fail-closed and household ASUS forwarding fail-open.
None of this continuation's changes alters those contracts.

After `9afe38b9` was pushed and independently verified, the execution workspace
reset. The clean checkout was restored from that exact GitHub commit. Pending
complete-MAX, Tor, AWG and Hysteria2 source snapshots and native fixtures were
not present in the restored workspace. Their earlier test receipts remain
historical observations, not proof of reconstructed bytes. Subsequent repairs
are reconstructed, tested and published as separate coherent changes; no old
snapshot is restored over newer `main`.

## Requirement index and actual remaining work

Number ranges below are taken from the repository's recovered audit comments.
They identify the historical groups; wording in this table is a paraphrase.
The later corrections and external-node additions overlap these groups.

| Requirement group | Current source/evidence index | Remaining requirement or evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1–15: owned sessions, progress, proof, rollback | Controller/native ownership tests; retained DNS, MTU, comparison and Speed Lab owners. | Physical reconnect, cancellation, leak and network-transition acceptance for each platform and requested graph. |
| 16–44: usable third-party Methods | Setup Center Methods generators and protocol import/URI suites. | Real off-LAN compatible-client imports and traffic, including historical SOCKS5/OverTLS/Shadowsocks cases. |
| 45–92: setup, administration, management | Authenticated agent/admin routes, Setup Center onboarding and connected-client controls. | Private-target Stop/Emergency Stop/Resume, kick/revoke/ban and forwarding acceptance. |

### Android Tor Server host adoption in this change

The real Tor form, StandardExit dispatcher and existing VpnService now carry
explicit Local or Server execution for a captured private Router entry. Plain
Tor and all five bridge choices retain the exact entry mode, Start Layer,
credentials, selected DNS, IPv6, LAN and MTU policy. The staged metadata binds
the complete native graph, both profiles, session and predecessor graph hash.
A real native execution receipt must match the captured request before the app
reports Connected. Complete profiles, Startup Last and Speed Lab restoration
preserve Server instead of replacing it with Local or rerunning Compare.

Disconnect and asynchronous cancellation revoke data immediately. The service
joins retryable hop, DNS and MTU measurement owners before retaining its Box, TUN
and entry until the exact Server lease acknowledges DELETE.
During that bounded native close only, the already-cancelled Server owner may
bind new cleanup sockets to its captured unchanged physical network. A retained
MAX entry requires exact source and physical readback; changed Home selection
cannot reopen data. The eight-second admission is cleared on both success and
failure. Pending cleanup stays retryable and cannot release replacement owners.

Focused evidence: 342 actual Java/Go Server graphs and 6,541 assertions, alongside
348 Local graphs and 20,613 assertions; 4,363 real-form assertions and 162 compiler
roundtrips; 983 proof/service lifecycle assertions and thirteen rejected mutations;
561 real MAX preparation assertions and 55 full-service assertions; full service
compilation and four broken-signature guards; 1,729 profile assertions across
130 cases; 935 startup assertions; 941 Speed Lab restore assertions and twelve
mutations; 2,014 permission assertions; and the actual runtime teardown suite.
The unchanged MTU suite passes 118 assertions and six negative controls.

Java platform/native handles are boundary doubles in these host tests. The
actual native parser gate is wired to all 690 Local/Server graphs, with eight
pinned-gate contract tests passing. That 690-graph native run was **not** performed
locally: this workspace lacks the required verified Tor DSO and LLVM 21. It
remains exact-SHA CI evidence, as do APK packaging and physical Android tests.

### Apple Tor Server host adoption

The existing PacketTunnel engine dispatches Server profiles to the shared
Server compiler and one `routervpn-server-tor` owner in the same native Box.
Its immutable metadata captures execution, both profiles, predecessor graph,
session and complete native configuration. Server creates no local Tor process
or local Tor state directory. Selected-DNS and actual client-path public Tor
proof precede a usable receipt; a server-ready lease alone cannot connect.

Cancellation revokes data before draining captured hop, DNS and MTU operations.
The MTU owner keeps its physical network monitor while the entry carries exact
DELETE cleanup. Failed close retains the native proof, Box, platform and staged
source, and rejects a replacement start until cleanup is acknowledged. Retry
uses the captured owner and never a replacement connection. Local/Server choice
survives full profile CRUD, Startup Last and temporary Speed Lab restoration.
Startup Last now fingerprints the validated Tor entry slot instead of the
ordinary-external slot. Compare remains rejected pending real scoring inputs.

Focused evidence: 342 actual Swift/Go Server graphs and 6,479 assertions;
348 Local graphs, 285 Home-DNS variants, 2,025 ordinary-entry/execution/layer/
OpenVPN graphs and 320 device-policy combinations in the 39,888-assertion Local
gate; four Swift 6 engine variants with 670/670/671/670 checks and five Server
defect mutations; MTU cleanup with six rejected mutations; complete profile
CRUD across 288 cases and 6,676 checks with five original mutations; 1,443
execution/Startup Last checks; and 131 ordinary-external ownership checks.
The exported Server inventory contains 342 directories and 793 hashed files.
The native gate requires all 690 Local/Server graphs and both outbound
registrations, with nine gate contract tests passing. The actual 690-graph
native run and Xcode build were not performed in this workspace; they remain
exact-SHA CI requirements alongside real-device networking and distribution.

### Tor comparison and restoration continuation through `07d89bfd`

This continuation resolves the earlier Tor Compare source gap across the
desktop controller and both mobile hosts. The selected private Router entry,
exit source, DNS and protection policy remain captured throughout the round.
Local and Server use the same randomly selected external target. Each valid
candidate scores `(last_node_response_time + external_response_time) / 2`, and
the selected path repeats both operands before retention. A failed initial or
final trial has no score. The Tor last-node operand is the captured final
relay's HTTP response; it is distinct from external HTTP, circuit setup time,
SENDME timing and ICMP RTT.

These are shipping implementation and executable-test findings. Controlled
native C/Go/Java/Swift fixtures do not establish a public Tor circuit, an actual
system VPN on every device, or a completed release.

## Native gates, release and live evidence

The initial `dbff30e8` Actions read found 20 push runs: 11 failed and nine
successful. That is a historical diagnosis, not the current release status.
The subsequent changes address observed failures while preserving their
negative tests. Native Windows Tor cross compilation succeeded in diagnostic
run [40608694158](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40608694158);
its Windows AMD64 job then exposed the separate DNS fixture failure fixed above.
Its Darwin AMD64 job exposed the empty-array Bash failure fixed in `15b988c6`,
and Windows ARM64 exposed the file-metadata API mismatch fixed in `a5876568`.
These observed failures are not reported as current native successes.

The mobile host graph inventory is 348 existing Local/direct + 342 Server +
48 new ordinary-entry graphs per platform. Both complete 738-graph native gates
passed before publication in `e5b2d191`, with all 738 missing-engine controls
per host. Their first actual runs exposed a missing OpenVPN build tag and an
incomplete local Xray preparation; both were corrected without removing graphs
or weakening constructors. The full pinned composition was exercised with the
verified C Tor DSO and required Go/LLVM/Swift toolchains. The previous ledger's
missing-tool limitation no longer describes this workspace. The native gate
does not start a VPN or public Tor circuit and is not an Apple SDK/device test.

The final mobile activation retains those 738 cases per host and adds **224
Android** and **528 Apple** enabled Local configurations. The added matrix
covers plain Tor and obfs4 at default/32/64/192 rates, direct/private/ordinary
entries, and the explicitly enumerated Apple entry-layer combinations. The
original matrix retains all six Tor/PT kinds; these counts are not a claim to
have exercised every possible transport/rate/layer combination. Android rejects
738 original missing-engine cases plus 448 enabled missing-engine/changed-source
cases. Apple rejects all 1,266 missing-engine cases and 528 changed-source cases.
Both final runs match their before/after source, prepared copy, module and
native package identities; Apple checks 866 source inputs. No failed source
snapshot was relabeled as a new run.

After the measurement and fixed-bridge changes, the exact `1ff69540` Actions
query returned 26 runs. The source publication/secret, repository, weighted,
Setup Center status/admin and profile traversal gates had passed; native and
authoritative release jobs were still queued, pending or running. Earlier
`f327b0b6` jobs include superseded cancellations. These observations do not
establish a completed release for either commit.

The later exact `d08cf0f1` read shows successful map-first, native UI,
release-blocker, kill-switch, source-publication/secret, repository and weighted
gates. Its native build and authoritative release jobs were still queued,
pending or running at that read. After the public macOS deadline repair,
[`78ca1410`](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/commit/78ca14106c9966bf3485e5e1b52f6d29e022f402)
was verified as the remote branch head. Its Actions query returned 25 runs,

The authoritative run is
[40634757771](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40634757771).
These are point-in-time observations; later main commits require their own
build, asset, checksum, image and compose verification.

The later exact `96a60324` read returned 20 workflow runs, with the authoritative
run [40638470632](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40638470632)
still pending. Repository, source-publication/secret, weighted and Setup Center
status gates had passed; remaining returned runs were pending, queued or running.
The number of workflows returned at that point is an observation, not a reduced
release asset or platform requirement. This is not completed release evidence.

The complete local Go package run passed the controller (251.815s) and shared
packages. Its isolated relay container-context fixture encountered a local
ancestor VCS discovery error; that one fixture passed separately in 5.337s with
`GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false`, matching the Docker COPY context's absence of VCS
metadata. No production build or source protection was changed for that local

receipt-cancellation revision was also independently rerun through its lifecycle,

## Concrete remaining implementation and evidence

- Finish unmodified shipping Windows compiler/native composition after the
  prospective bootstrap and real Wintun gates passed on both architectures.
  The passing prospective overlay is still not public feature admission.
- Complete installed and Portable Windows administrator/controller startup,
  private authenticated transport, original-user data identity, repeated launch
  and shutdown ownership, including distinct-account UAC.
- Complete ordinary/fixed Windows protection migration. Private Router and
  bounded ordinary-external handoffs now retain exact tuples; that alone does
  not replace the legacy global firewall-profile mechanism or implement
  physically negotiated SOCKS UDP through an owned per-socket broker.
- Resolve actual Intel/Apple Silicon kernel and installed-controller failures,
  execute every required native mutant, then validate the final unmodified
  Darwin compiler and shipping host composition before public admission.
- Preserve all other original requirement families and the preceding ledgers.
  Source, local tests, push, native build, package publication, deployment and
  physical acceptance remain distinct states.

No current all-platform release or private deployment is claimed. Physical
networking/leaks/transitions, off-LAN interoperability, real visual/accessibility
checks, private benchmarking/forwarding/management/updater/provider checks,
production signing/distribution and deliberate ASUS/Portainer deployment still
need their appropriate live evidence. No router, private deployment or signing
environment was changed for these commits.

## Historical Windows execution at the initial inventory cutoff

At [`0fe5db88`, job 123801083431](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40974825453/job/123801083431),
the real imported-socket/WFP traffic and renewal test passed TCP4, TCP6, UDP4
and UDP6. Completed-local address, port, family and read-error negatives passed;
all 14 identity defects were rejected. The WFP gate passed 17 baseline/kernel
and lifecycle cases, 12 production defects and three fixture controls, plus
blocked-I/O/source-port, process-death and traffic-bypass cases. That job failed
separately on UAC and the then-rejected system PowerShell image; it was not an
overall successful workflow.

The system-image repair in `77c2393c` uses the OS-selected system directory,
retained file/ancestor handles, trusted owner/DACL and captured exact link
count. It admits the real servicing hardlink without weakening generic
user-file hardlink rejection. Actual Windows GUI job `123801995819` at
`a8b7945d` passed 19 cases and 17 production defects. At
[`6c7610d2`, job 123813071986](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40978664335/job/123813071986),
the extended GUI gate passed 20 cases and the same 17 defects, including
original-user folders and actual system PowerShell. Pinned TLS, C# requests
under PowerShell 5.1 and 7, one Framework-compiled DLL loaded in both runtimes,
and the actual C# pipe-to-TLS composition also passed. Its first actual
PowerShell adapter case timed out before connection during cold startup.

At [`b5e8238c`, job 123816658877](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40979551759/job/123816658877),
the shipping child-entry/catalog gate passed in 2 minutes 50 seconds. It
exercises actual captured child preparation, original-user policy and immutable
catalog admission; it does not establish complete launcher composition.
Several actual PowerShell adapter cases still exceeded the old combined
startup deadline. `cfa32660` separates bounded 45-second process/pipe startup
from the unchanged 15-second authenticated-frame deadline, and requires a
delayed-start case. It does not widen the authenticated exchange.

At [`e0adb559`, job 123821908780](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40980638164/job/123821908780),
the child-entry/catalog, TLS, GUI framing, both-shell adapter, native GUI Job,
actual C# composition and **actual PowerShell adapter** steps passed. The full
installed/Portable Session step stopped before application startup: its ACL
fixture launched Windows PowerShell 5.1 with inherited PowerShell 7 module
paths, so `Microsoft.PowerShell.Security`/`Set-Acl` could not load. `e9aa4411`
selects the actual system PowerShell Modules directory for this fixture and
moves the unchanged Session test and defects into an independent mandatory
job. The production Session already builds the captured module environment.

The next actual Session job, `123828716054` at `e9aa4411`, reached production
controller startup but failed its 30.10-second readiness deadline. This is
neither App/Tray acceptance nor evidence that the fixture repair was sufficient
to complete the launcher. The subsequent kernel self-image fix is recorded
below; its corrected native execution remains required.

The prospective Windows bootstrap workflow at `e0adb559`,
[run 40980638076](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40980638076),
passed both AMD64 and ARM64 jobs (`123820654132`, `123820654520`), including
compiler/Box/WFP/selected-DNS checks and the separate actual Wintun ownership
and retirement gate. This remains bounded bootstrap evidence: public Tor
admission, complete route/wrapper connection and physical-device behavior are
not established by it.

**UAC remains an actual failing boundary.** Stable-GUID Shell execution still
fails before proved child creation. The two `e0adb559` foundation failures are
the actual elevated-launch and drive-rebinding cases. The `6fac7f93`/`2bf1e782`
failure-only suspended-Shell diagnostics compile on both architectures,
including checkptr instrumentation. At `21a4f0a7`, the
[actual short job 123826885954](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40982870214/job/123826885954)
observed one creation callback, the added `CREATE_SUSPENDED` flag, the retained
Shell process, successful image/token readback and one prior suspension on
its initial thread. No fixture connection occurred; the exact child was
terminated and joined without resuming it. This proves the diagnostic's
suspension, not a usable standard-user or cross-account UAC launch.
`8cd8ec3b`, `0d92a788` and `21a4f0a7` make the same existing test independently
observable without removing the comprehensive gate. No unverified DOS-path
fallback or public admission was added.

## Historical macOS execution at the initial inventory cutoff

At `1e774728`, Intel job `123799860371` passed all three UID-retirement tests
and the fresh native observer request/reply negatives. Other PF traffic cases
failed then; those failures are not silently counted as passes.

At `a8b7945d`, ARM job `123801814098` passed the actual AppKit controller
client, retained supervisor/peer and owned-cleanup tests. The earlier repeated
launch had found the shared install root incorrectly changed from 0755 to
0700; `a8b7945d` preserves traversal while keeping private runtime state
private. The following installer tests failed on the fixture's `/var` versus
`/private/var` alias. `cfc62e55` captures physical fixture roots; 17 local
installer tests and six negative controls pass. A corrected native installer
rerun is still required by this record.

At [`c56a10cf`, ARM job 123819444704](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40980613683/job/123819444704),
all baseline kernel cases passed: TCP/UDP over both address families, capacity
retirement (98.24 seconds), normal UID retirement, wrong UID, real utun,
owner crashes, foreign blocked traffic, entered-I/O/source-port cleanup,
descriptor retirement, floating state and stale captures. The runner then
rejected its first eight production defects before stopping on a stale
per-socket descriptor-retirement mutation selector. `5fd7c7d` corrects that
selector for file and native socket owners; the complete corrected native
negative gate remains required.

The same run's Intel job `123819444880` passed all four traffic families and
normal UID retirement, but the capacity case lost its heartbeat after five
packets/155 bytes. `b0d5c4af` starts the readback deadline after serialized
stream admission; `a81d707d` joins fixture echo connections during cleanup.
Their native rerun remains required. The corresponding Linux stream-admission
repair is `9c982f1d`; these source changes do not establish a current all-green
Darwin or Linux release.

## Historical shipping composition and focused local evidence

The Windows child now authenticates its actual launcher pipe peer and retained
process, captures original-user token folders, validates immutable package
catalogs, publishes only captured public drain fields, and retains its owned
lifetime. API/shutdown secrets stay in the private pipe; writable generated
catalogs do not become privileged command authority. The shared Session owns
controller, TLS proof, original-user App/Tray Job and retirement. Actual
installed/Portable command entry points have not yet adopted it. Fresh Portable
Data initialization is also required; the current native Session fixture seeds
that state and therefore does not prove a new generic ZIP's first launch.

`5cbc9d13` moves exactly three preference files into the authenticated data
root: onboarding, selected mode and custom presets. Existing destination files
win, original legacy files survive, and link/unsafe-ancestor rejection is
preserved. Local actual-file checks and eight production defects pass; the
profile/device/Help/adapter regressions pass. `f2730e4b` requires the new
UIState module in both Windows package preflights and rejects a deliberately
missing module. All 12 package-gate tests pass. Actual packaged Windows state
migration remains separately required; the earlier `e0adb559` native run does
not contain this later change.

Full-audit-v4 completed successfully. A broad Go execution lost its tool
session, so its partial output was not accepted as a pass. An isolated rerun
of exact `e9aa4411` completed with every package except `internal/common`
passing. Its sole failure was `TestAndroidAmneziaExactProfileSelection` because
the environment had Java but no `javac`. After supplying JDK 17.0.20, that
exact package passed in 14.729 seconds. Every Go package therefore passed
across the complete run and affected-package retry. The initial run was not
all green, and this does not replace native platform execution.

## Follow-up after the inventory cutoff

[`90c426ede026bff1a4e293156b06feb06f0586d2`](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/commit/90c426ede026bff1a4e293156b06feb06f0586d2)
derives self-image capture from the running kernel process. It repairs the
observed mismatch between `QueryFullProcessImageName` and the spelling returned
by `os.Executable` in Session/controller startup. Both AMD64 and ARM64
controller, Session and actual `cmd/client` compile, with a compiled regression
case. Its [actual native rerun, job 123833052394](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/40984756063/job/123833052394),
passes launch and private hello in 0.28 seconds, then the full controller exits
before pinned-TLS identity proof and cleanup reports a missing shutdown
receipt. That new startup failure remains under diagnosis. This is not a
completed UAC, App/Tray or launcher-adoption claim.

## Remaining delivery work at the initial inventory cutoff

- Finish and prove installed/Portable launcher adoption, fresh Portable Data
  initialization and stable UAC execution while retaining exact image, token,
  private-pipe and process ownership. Preserve relocation, saved private stores
  and clean exit of owned processes.
- Complete ordinary external Windows per-socket WFP integration and the
  negotiated SOCKS UDP path. Work in progress in the shared tree is not part
  of this published inventory. Existing fixed helpers still require their
  actual owned-socket migration; no fixed relay port is invented.
- Complete corrected Intel/ARM macOS kernel negative gates, installer reruns,
  heartbeat evidence and applicable Linux native gates. Retain real failure
  witnesses rather than deleting a failing protection case.
- Finish applicable full-ledger platform/graph requirements and verify the
  exact resulting SHA across native packages, images, compose, checksums and
  authoritative publication. The historical green `745b3e41` release does not
  establish current source or release completion.
- Carry out the separately authorized live acceptance: physical-device
  networking, leaks, reconnect/transitions, off-LAN methods, visual and
  accessibility checks, private benchmarks/forwarding/stop/resume/rollback,
  AI providers, Apple signing/notarization/distribution, persistent Android
  signing/upgrades and deliberate AI Board/ASUS deployment and regression.

No live router, private deployment, credentials or signing environment was
changed for this continuation record. The preceding ledgers remain preserved.

### Windows: actual corrected Session execution

The first complete corrected installed **and fresh Portable** Session job passed
at [`bb8d1ab8`, job 123938889135](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41018094202/job/123938889135).
It executed the shipping controller and packaged App/Tray, authenticated both
native channels, preserved private configuration and UI preferences, obtained
checked controller retirement and joined the owned processes. Installed
execution took 50.77 seconds; Portable execution took 8.37 seconds. The same job
passed retirement retry, foreign-launcher and hardlinked-code rejection, plus
two compiled production negative controls. Its native Portable preparation
passed nine groups, seven unsafe-existing-state cases and five production
negative controls, including real namespace retention and release. This is
actual Windows/AMD64 execution, not an ARM64 or ordinary-user UAC claim.

The failures leading to this result were concrete. `33f4eec8` reads registered
machine paths without expanding inherited environment substitutions, using
captured kernel roots. The actual `33f4eec8` and later short native jobs passed
ordinary, missing and poisoned environment cases. `c763fdd0` changes only the
ACL fixture's requested read rights so inspection does not conflict with live
code pins. Failure-only GUI instrumentation in `4a981243` then showed that
Windows PowerShell 5.1 CodeDOM rejected the volume-GUID TEMP spelling.
`c7e60047` captures a DOS spelling that independently resolves to the same
private Portable generated directory; `bb8d1ab8` gives its retained directory
handles sharing-relevant read access. That final repair is exercised by the
successful full Session job above.

The independent executable-ancestor regression also passed at
[`1d65de11`, job 123938166667](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41017860638/job/123938166667).
It duplicates only the actual ancestor handles, closes the executable leaf,
and checks local, volume-GUID and DOS-subdirectory spellings. Rename remains
blocked until those handles retire; afterward a distinct equal-byte file can
replace the namespace. This prevents an open executable leaf from masking an
ineffective directory pin. The protection-record and controller-data variants
have their own native cases and compiled negative controls; their results must
be read independently rather than inferred from the image test.

`9e1c4c9a` fixes the updater's parser to accept the actual four-field package
provenance while rejecting malformed, duplicate and ambiguous fields.
`aea7be1e` captures the correct installed or Portable provenance file, explicit
current SHA, original-user private cache and retained updater Job. Windows
notifications now remain in that process instead of launching an ambient
PowerShell interpreter. Its exact staged Session fixtures and actual updater
binaries compiled with pointer checks on AMD64 and ARM64; neutral race tests
passed. The later actual Windows/AMD64 Session at
[`03b5b658`, job 123941285563](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41018850334/job/123941285563)
then passed the complete installed/Portable composition again, all six updater
preparation groups, seven unsafe-state cases and four actual compiled production
negative controls. These establish native cache/provenance ownership; network
update download and public launcher adoption remain separate requirements.

The actual PowerShell 5.1 saved-state failure was reproduced in the shipping
CUSTOM/profile functions. `818b4d14` materializes JSON before enumerating
presets and serializes arrays explicitly. A new short mandatory job in
`03b5b658` preserves both PowerShell versions and all eight executable
state-ownership negatives independently of the longer controller gate. Its
[first native result](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41018850334/job/123941285264)
passed the original preset-preservation boundary and stopped at the added
empty-collection check. `3ec8824e` explicitly enumerates each preset and checks
empty JSON structurally, including permitted whitespace. All 51 local state
checks and eight executable negative controls pass under PowerShell 7.6.9;
the corrected actual Windows job at
[`3ec8824e`, job 123942120568](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41019115466/job/123942120568)
also passed all 51 checks and eight negative controls in **both PowerShell 5.1
and 7**. The prior failed native observation is preserved above as the diagnosis,
not carried forward as an unresolved saved-state defect.

**Public launcher adoption and ordinary UAC are still unfinished.** The
successful Session composition does not replace the installed or Portable
command entry points by itself. Existing suspended-Shell image/thread proofs
pass under the elevated native runner, but the actual constructed Medium-token
probe at `febbdcdf` observes `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED` when trying to open the
higher-integrity initial thread. The linked-token test reports that the hosted
runner has no linked limited token; that unavailable observation is not a pass.
The `e68d7818` GLOBALROOT Shell probe fails before a creation callback.
`12004aa6` introduces a separate read-only capture of the protected global
mapping, exact file and original process identity. Its policies and compiled
negative controls pass locally, but native mapping/API/ACL execution and a
cooperative elevated broker remain unproved. No unverified launch fallback was
adopted.

`56c7724e` separates the exact unchanged linked-token test into an explicit UAC
acceptance case. Its independent native workflow step remains mandatory and
still fails when evidence is unavailable. The foundation now has 33 protocol
cases with all 24 compiled production mutation targets preserved, so unavailable
linked-token evidence no longer prevents those independent regressions from
executing. This is test scheduling and evidence separation, not UAC completion.

This is **not** automatic controller activation or a combined real-WFP,
encrypted-peer and physical-TUN acceptance result. Exact predecessor-to-successor

make that behavior equivalent to the strict native baseline.

control owner, revokes it on control EOF/unexpected data and synchronizes the

per-socket WFP authority for a negotiated relay tuple.

before mutation for wrong namespaces/targets and cancellation. Both ordinary

| Installed/Portable Windows ownership | Real corrected AMD64 Session, fresh private Data, App/Tray, saved configuration and checked retirement | Public command adoption; ordinary/cross-account UAC; actual update-download integration; ARM64 composed execution and packaged release |
| Native strict protection | Windows physical bootstrap/Wintun evidence; sealed ordinary/Node composition; immutable ownership preparation | Exact both-direction successor transfer, combined actual WFP/peer/TUN evidence, applicable family/layer adoption and safe crash recovery |

| Complete saved profiles/CUSTOM | Original private references and full mode/layer inputs preserved; actual 51-check saved-state regression and eight production defects in both PowerShell 5.1 and 7 | Remaining applicable full-ledger/profile/runtime acceptance |
| SOCKS UDP | Real TCP-control/UDP lifetime and endpoint race repair | Exact negotiated-relay physical authorization and full off-LAN interoperability |
| Cross-platform release | Coherent changes published with verified normal ancestry | One exact current SHA through all required native builds, packages, images, compose, manifests, checksums and publication |
| Live/device acceptance | No new private deployment or physical acceptance claimed | Authorized devices, off-LAN networking/leaks/transitions, visual/accessibility, private performance/forwarding/rollback/provider checks, signing and deliberate deployment |

The broader requirement ledger remains binding. No percentage or all-feature
completion follows from this table, a passing source audit or an isolated
native job. The Router/AI Board, ASUS forwarding, AdGuard, signing identities
and private deployment were not changed during these source publications.

Public activation requires explicit authenticated Off and durable crash
recovery in addition to completed native proofs. A crash journal must capture
the independently finalized old/new kernel target before commit acknowledgement;
a journal first written after Ready leaves an unrecorded installed-owner gap.
An unarmed failed release may be retried only after joining its partial owner
and independently proving the original unchanged target. Ordinary Close keeps
Always protection, and a failed retirement must not erase a replacement owner.

### Windows durable state and restart boundary

Normal release and explicit Off preserve the captured protection target,
request ownership, original source revision and exact private-profile write.
Write-through replacement is Windows-specific; the other platform path keeps
its original file/parent sync rules. Off retries retain the accepted intent
rather than inventing a new request or claiming success before storage and
native cleanup finish. Restored nodes keep the saved source identity while
acquiring a fresh runtime/session identity.

The native retained BFE observer is synchronous through its durable callback.
A successful callback alone is insufficient: the exact read-only transaction
must finish successfully, all witnesses must join, and native errors remain
failures even if comparison bytes were written. Cancellation prevents stale
admission and Close joins the captured operation. The portable observer suite
passed seven groups repeatedly under the race detector; three portable
negative controls were rejected and five native negative controls compiled.
The actual native step subsequently passed at the exact Windows SHA below.

The intact-journal recovery core has a separate admission boundary. It reads
only the retained protected store for the authenticated original desktop/Data
directory; checks a complete process snapshot or retained process creation,
primary token and exit; never signals a saved PID; and freezes the first
observed firewall outcome and immutable handover bytes. Ordinary Append still
cannot change controllers. An observed absence does not resurrect a prior
baseline, and pending Off retains original/result profile revisions.
Seventy portable race-test groups (477 cases) and four new portable defects
passed/rejected as intended; AMD64 and ARM64 native fixtures and three new
native defects compiled. The protected-file/process fixtures explicitly model
BFE, while the separate observer tests use real BFE. Public startup adoption
and recovered-Off private-store reconciliation remain the next app integration
unit at this cutoff. Torn/unknown peer slots and legacy unbound nonempty
records are not silently adopted.

### Application recovery is now wired into startup

The shipping application calls `initializeDesktopNodeRecovery` after actual
profile loading and before creating its HTTP listener. The Windows adapter uses
the retained bootstrap, original Data handle, actual controller identity and
native `ProtectionJournal`. A ten-second initial attempt leaves unresolved
owners and truthful pending status available for later captured retry.

The slot consumes an opaque checked recovery operation. A valid result with an
error is retained as evidence and cannot admit a successor. Repeated uncertain
results must be identical. Successful hydration requires native cleanup join,
exact journal readback, current firewall expectation and the original source
profile revision. Launch consumes that initialized journal before `slot.begin`
can capture its predecessor.

Pending Off retains the original accepted intent and both profile revisions.
Recovery checks real private-store bytes before removal/save and after saving.
An exact result already on disk is acknowledged without writing it again.
Completing the old request preserves the separately selected node and unrelated
profile/credential references. The actual joined native recovery owner can
carry an absence observation; a fabricated no-op release cannot.

Pre-admission recovery has its own cancellable app operation. Disconnect and
shutdown cancel it before waiting for the operation mutex, and mutation requests
also carry request cancellation. Completion clears only the captured pointer.
Terminal shutdown joins unresolved native resources while preserving durable
policy for the next controller; ordinary Disconnect cannot report unproved
removal. Torn/unknown records and unbound legacy nonempty records remain
preserved under their existing gates.

Verification: fourteen focused race groups / thirty-nine cases; broader
135 groups / 535 cases; repeated actual admission/request/shutdown cancellation;
eight new and two affected existing executable negative controls; sixteen
runner/audit tests; three product/private-state audits; and isolated Windows
AMD64/ARM64 native/checkptr compilation. Application tests model process/BFE/
journal I/O explicitly. Actual native core and application boundary execution
remain separate. A later Windows run failed printing Unicode before exposing
its native result; `d342000f` fixes that runner boundary with a real strict
cp1252 stream regression, including preservation of an exit-1 rejection.

owners remain retained for checked cleanup. No ordinary ENOENT, nil store,

### Real Linux protection readback

`8f7c8d01` adds `ObservePreparedProtection` and `ObserveRetiredProtection` on
the retained Linux source. Prepared observation is serialized with native
requests and requires no prior socket admission plus four exact empty owned
sets/rules. Socket activity is monotonic even if a receipt is lost. Retired
observation requires successful Close acknowledgment and both native joins,
then independently reads the original closed baseline. Unknown cleanup,
nonempty sets, duplicate/foreign objects, dormant tables, changed handles and

transaction across later durable acknowledgment. The current Linux guardian
has no separate On-connect/Always field; the next host/journal integration must
bind the chosen protection policy explicitly.

package cross-compiles passed. The existing namespace teardown regression also
passed, preserving failure/signal results and rejecting both teardown defects.

### Inactive native Linux firewall tables

The existing active guardian verified the retained table handle but did not
check its flags. A dormant table could therefore keep that identity while
suspending evaluation of its base chains. The
[nftables manual](https://netfilter.org/projects/nftables/manpage.html)
describes that native dormant-table behavior. The new predicate accepts only
absent flags or an empty flag array. Unknown, malformed and nonempty flags are
rejected during initial capture and active verification. Exact permit cleanup
does not require treating an inactive baseline as valid protection.

All thirteen real race-instrumented guardian groups passed on Linux 6.18.57,
Go 1.26.3 and nftables/libnftables 1.0.9 in fresh isolated namespaces. Their
reported group durations total 56.58 seconds. The two new cases show that:

- A running owner loses Current after actual table dormancy and cannot transmit
  its rejected marker. An independent live UDP peer still works, so an unrelated
  peer failure cannot explain the rejection.
- New preparation refuses the disabled baseline before allocating its isolated
  account. Cleanup preserves the actual table identity and complete baseline.

The registered single-predicate old-behavior mutation failed both exact native
assertions. Five parser groups passed three race-instrumented repetitions and
the Linux ARM64 tagged test binary compiled. Production and fixture timeouts
were unchanged. The frozen four-file manifest digest is
`c5908d7abcb2b8e5a575ee4b845cb3930294f1fc7ccce61ab79575917efcbbf5`,
validation receipt digest
`2cc352c8030336e47325d250f867e67e926ddac395da330cc65d6f8a8d977842`
and patch digest
`a66791d2cefd7c05f3569c57bd786459671e31556517bcd833e9b38e64fab741`.

The local nftables version rendered dormant flags as unstable JSON string
values while its sets changed. Production rejects all such values. Only the
test uses an additional exact native text readback to prove the dormant bit
survives cleanup, together with unchanged table/rule identity and actual packet
observations. No production compatibility exception or flag whitelist was added.
This is Linux kernel evidence, not completed public parent/journal admission,
macOS lifecycle, a hosted release or physical-device acceptance.

### Profile-helper startup delay and explicit package loading

At [`27eb9491`, instrumented job 124421906988](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41162175978/job/124421906988),
the first qualified filesystem command took 0.0342322 seconds, while the complete

located 45.2144777 seconds inside loading `RouterVPN-Windows-ProfileSettings.ps1`
out of a 45.8473583-second helper group. The actual file read took 0.0013132
seconds. All other helper loads were below half a second on that run.

The helper used `Get-Command` to ask whether its UI-state function was already
loaded. Microsoft documents that an
[exact-name Get-Command lookup searches available modules and can import one](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/get-command?view=powershell-5.1).
The corrected helper inspects the loaded Function drive and imports the known
packaged state module only when absent, retaining its existing captured
transport and UTF-8 ScriptBlock composition.

The PowerShell 7.4.6 semantic fixture loads the actual helper with an unrelated
discoverable module exporting the same function. Both absent and already-loaded
packaged state cases preserve the exact module/controller objects. Reinstating
the old lookup executes the unrelated module and is rejected by its independent
file witness. The existing 51 UI-state/consumer checks and six instrumentation
preservation tests pass. Windows CI executes the same loading and system-command
probes in PowerShell 5.1 and 7 after its independent first-launch observation.
Fresh native results and reduced cold timing remain pending for `d02bc9f6`;
local functional proof is not a native timing measurement.

### Public connection, cancellation and restoration

The Windows host now supplies captured controller/package authority, native
verification and child creation to the real public handlers. The host cannot
select or compile another profile, stage different inputs, accept a proof, or
restore a connection. Those operations remain the shipping application path.
App and private Data roots are distinct; a restore retains the original host,
private source and complete configuration while acquiring the latest joined
protection predecessor. Unsupported protected graphs reject before Stop, keep
their catalog entries and remain requirements to implement.

The initiating operation is captured through preparation, staging, child
creation, admission, actual HTTP proof and final publication. Final Connected,
SMART retention and restore publication check that operation and the exact
command/native owner under the application mutex. Cancellation or a late
completion cannot adopt another request, command, or native map entry even
when the latter reuses the same command. An ordinary child that actually starts
just before cancellation retains its exact cleanup identity so its real Stop
command executes; it is never acknowledged as Connected. Failed native join or
explicit Off retains its owner, private source and workspace until exact retry.
The Start Layer capability response uses captured active policy and current
native readiness instead of today's mutable saved selection.

The isolated sixteen-file candidate passed 142 parent groups / 435 groups and
subcases under Go's race detector in 118.827 seconds. Nine public groups include
24 Connect mode/layer combinations, complete AUTO/SMART selection, cancelled
Speed Lab restoration, four replacement/cancellation boundaries, failed
Disconnect/Off retry, capability truth and ordinary Stop cleanup. The private
host and HTTP transport boundaries are modeled; the real catalog, compiler,
private-file protocol, public handlers and HTTP parser execute. The ordinary
cleanup case also starts a real local process. Seventeen runner/source tests
and baseline Windows AMD64/ARM64 native-tag builds with checkptr=2 passed.

All eight new production mutants were subsequently rejected at their intended

## Captured Linux parent and split/raw-MAX admission

`8a638acd` retains the actual authenticated installed Linux controller rather
than reconstructing a parent from serialized records. The capture binds the
original user-created anonymous pipe, install/process locks, protected root
and executable, process start, namespaces, credentials and controller lifetime.
Native replacement or original GUI death permanently revokes that capture.
Application capture also requires the same controller and fixed private roots.
The parent closes only its own added handles; original controller descriptors
remain borrowed until its join succeeds. Exact already-closed Go handles can
retire, while a genuine native close failure remains sticky across retries.

The isolated seven-file unit passed twelve focused groups three times under
the race detector, 34 related HTTP/teardown groups, and the full source/binary
pinned native namespace gate: eight parent groups including thirteen added
native cases. All seven deliberate defects were rejected. Linux AMD64 native
race, Linux ARM64, Windows AMD64 native/checkptr and Darwin ARM64 builds passed;
cross-compiles do not claim native execution on those other targets. The
manifest digest is
`c75a4fbcfb491ccf7f1be573166bbc758e0d38aadfc0a46517a67c3d7e544969`,
and the validation receipt digest is
`9d51ae23e692a2b9d6774710f0bb921b5bc64e5c245c2cd345f6d9e653e97092`.
The Linux durable journal, child admission, Always succession and public Node
activation remain unfinished subsequent integration.

`7517ed24` extends the owned Node gate to `split` and raw `max`. Split preserves
REALITY/Vision TCP plus its original Hysteria2 UDP branch; raw MAX preserves
PQ-REALITY/Vision TCP plus its original Hysteria2 UDP branch. These are distinct

## Linux durable protection journal

`d5c973e7` retains a private sibling journal outside the replaceable installed
package directory. The original parent, directory, file inodes, exclusive
flock and controller locks remain captured. An immutable header and two bounded
slots use durable flush/readback; a partial write retains its exact pending
record for a matching retry, preserving the prior acknowledged slot.
Cancellation after a durable write may return the saved selection together
with an error. The caller must retain that intent and refuse acknowledgment.

Journal records describe On-connect, Always and Off intent; they cannot recreate
native authority. Creation requires actual absence observations before and
afterward. Errors and a foreign nft table are not absence. Close retains genuine
errors and all journal files; a failed join retains the flock and original
controller locks. Parent shutdown joins its dependents outside the readback
lock, so partial constructors are also owned.

Twelve actual Linux namespace parent groups passed, including seventeen new
journal cases and a retained-anchor case. Nineteen focused race groups passed
three times, all nine compiled defects were rejected, and Linux AMD64 native/
race, Linux ARM64, Windows AMD64 and Darwin ARM64 compilations passed. Actual
preparation copied all 129 production mobiletor sources and compiled the new
Linux reader. The manifest digest is
`67e11510e270ebe365f31faa7d47d971668bd4d6fe03f26aacecdeb074af83e3`;
the validation receipt is
`ebb0c9c00e34ba51a9ba09363d1b7d70e45ab3a9fadae0ab8999c14b30ef1b89`.
These private-namespace tests changed no host network policy. The authenticated
child channel, real child/native admission, Always succession and public Linux
activation still require their own implementation and acceptance.

The completed [Windows PQ run 41180523686](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41180523686)
at `d7d55208` contains different failures on its two architectures. ARM64 timed
out in the old thirty-second private ACL preparation, before key generation.
AMD64 passed all six WG-PQ/AWG-PQ traffic cases across Off/AES/AES+XOR in
240.85 seconds, then failed ten KEM/AES credential leaves because the fixture
did not observe native authenticated rejection inside its two-second startup
window. All six wrong packet-key leaves passed. The fixture correction above
addresses the inconsistent bound and adds phase/counter diagnostics; only the
new actual native execution can establish whether it resolves that failure.
Neither timeout nor generic transport failure substitutes for rejection.

The local complete-MAX candidate separately passed seven actual native PQ ABI
prerequisites, twelve traffic cases and forty-eight credential cases. Its
compiled control runner needed a specific live lower-policy denial witness
after Xray collapsed an asynchronous error. The repaired first two controls
passed; an environment interruption stopped the following focused run before
a complete receipt. These unpublished observations are not an aggregate pass,
Windows WFP acceptance, public admission or release proof.

The staged public controller exposed two concrete integration issues: the
published MAX Start Layer asset fix above, and a still-unpublished logical
base-preference update that invalidates the newly proved source when saved
after connection. ALL tests exercise actual public fallback, cancellation,
joined protection and captured Speed Lab restoration; these remain unfinished
until the transaction and native acceptance are complete.

The new Linux retained owner has real kernel evidence, but local
`/dev/net/tun` is absent and creation in a disposable private namespace was
denied. The complete TUN/selected-DNS gate remains mandatory on the real Linux
runner. The macOS installer still refuses a live process whose executable
path cannot be independently resolved; process name, ENOENT and generic
platform signing are not accepted as proof of absence or foreign ownership.

No new all-platform release, signed distribution, physical-device/off-LAN
acceptance, private benchmark/provider acceptance, AI Board/Portainer
deployment or ASUS forwarding change is established here. The original full
requirement scope remains open at those boundaries.

### Published foundation versus remaining implementation

The current Linux foundation has retained DNS, original Stop/fallback,
independent runtime options, monitoring and legacy-transition preflight.
Daily-use Connect still needs the complete shipping composition. The pending
MTU lease integration must make ordinary Stop and terminal shutdown reach
authenticated retirement when an exited engine cannot acknowledge rollback.
Fixed/Auto status must read the actual interface; SMART and Speed Lab must
restore sealed inputs and the proved execution, and their path identity must
include the retained Linux owner. Native cover activation remains required;
the legacy ambient UDP sender is not an acceptable substitute. These are
source gaps, not merely requests for physical access. Saved-policy Off,
cross-owner guard succession, crash recovery and retained Always recovery
also retain their existing requirements.

The latest release observation remains the twelve-asset `745b3e41` prerelease.
This newer source series has no verified all-green exact-SHA release. Live
devices, off-LAN paths, production signing, private deployment and
ASUS/Portainer acceptance remain separate. No live target was changed.

## Linux ownership and generated child

Ordered shutdown passed eight actual namespace scenarios alongside the seven
durable transaction cases and eleven native control cases. Five compiled
defects demonstrated the ordered shutdown hook, cancellation ordering,
retirement-only journal authority, replacement-command guard and retention of
closed Always. Linux ARM64 and Windows AMD64 compilation are recorded
separately from the actual Linux AMD64 execution. The shutdown manifest digest
is `763794829ff304e96f4012cd2431ea2d947120fc3e4f8584c7bf974f69370da7`.

The prepared-host unit passed eleven new actual namespace cases and all
twenty-six combined transaction/shutdown/host cases. Five compiled defects
failed at the exact changed-network, changed-runtime-option, changed-private-
input, replaced-request and entered-command boundaries. Linux ARM64 compilation
also passed. Package metadata verification is explicitly modeled in this
fixture; installed controller capture, private compilation, filesystem and
native namespace ownership are actual. Manifest digest:
`8699509c53fb0594a7d439c73dd8698556433220d325c0d68045e7a8178938cf`.

The generated child authenticates original channel FD3, parent directory FD4
and exact engine image FD5 before private input reads. It independently
recompiles the captured input and compares the complete configuration and
selection. It retains the actual Box preparation, including a source created
before service-manager initialization, and requires the real graph/source join
before terminal retirement. Final acknowledgment and strict receive EOF do not
replace the parent's original `Cmd.Wait` or durable settlement.

Ten actual child namespace cases passed. Five independently compiled defects
were rejected for private input before authentication, lost unstarted-source
retirement, ignored configuration, ignored selection digest, and an inherited
FD5 leak into a descendant. Shared command/MTU race tests, 22 preparation tests,
four verdict controls and the six-target build contract passed. The child
manifest binds 651 source records and 35 evidence hashes; its digest is
`bfdf319d4cc2895f7f088077f44188a60d3ac2aebd9b60e2a064f823c6da7012`.
Windows AMD64 Go-only compilation and Android build-constraint inventory are
bounded additional results, not native execution on those platforms.

The host start/retire composition passed twelve new namespace cases and all
38 transaction/shutdown/host cases in the same race-instrumented executable.
Five independently compiled defects were rejected for launching over an
occupied connection, reporting Connected before proof, discarding an unjoined
partial child, omitting On-connect release and clearing replacement state.
Linux ARM64 compilation passed separately. An independent review traced the
exact partial-process, journal and Always-successor ownership. The manifest
digest is `003e5cab8828862b244a67a7cb297773d8b0854f2a520403cffc8826b29ce06e`.
The native fixture models graph readiness and does not establish TUN traffic,
selected DNS or authenticated Router proof.

### Generated TUN and retained Router proof follow-up

The earlier local TUN attempt returned EPERM when creating the required device
node; no workaround was attempted. The separately provisioned native hosts
then executed the real generated command at `2533e146`. Both
[AMD64 job 124720903401](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41263267797/job/124720903401)
and [ARM64 job 124720903555](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/actions/runs/41263267797/job/124720903555)
passed all six required cases: On-connect, Always, captured MTU, MTU rollback,
selected-resolver failure and wrong key. Their actual native suites took
24.56 and 23.91 seconds. Each requires the exact TUN to close before terminal
acknowledgment and the original command to join. Nine runner checks also
passed on each host. This closes that generated-command TUN/DNS gate; it does
not establish the application Router-proof or complete installed-bundle gate.

`86e0491b` adds actual running-policy readback against the original captured
destinations, interface identities and prepared record. Ten new native kernel
cases and the complete 21-parent guardian suite passed; four compiled defects
rejected substituted destinations, inventory, prepared record and interface.
The same current kernel observation is used by the later host proof, rather
than inferring policy from a saved configuration.

`a765d0bb` adds a separate, fixed private Router HTTP reference behind plain
SS2022 only when an optional canonical node identity is supplied. The existing
selected Home DNS and generic inner routes remain unchanged. Seven actual
encrypted-peer cases passed for correct identity, wrong identity, restoration,
fresh selected DNS, wrong key, unrelated target and plaintext. The real HTTP
listener, active handlers and forwarding owners join before cleanup. This
test reference does not itself prove a TUN or an installed application.

`b47620ee` retains the exact readiness record and current TUN/MTU owner, binds
the proof socket by kernel interface index, reads back both index and name,
and rechecks the original policy and complete captured source around the
private Router HTTP exchange. Four pure race groups, nine actual native socket
cases, eleven prepared-host cases, twelve started-host cases and four compiled
defects passed. These native socket tests use real isolated interfaces; their
TUN/readiness boundaries remain explicit and do not stand in for the assembled
encrypted host gate. `0419f6cd` separately passed all fourteen real native
control cases and three compiled defects: caller cancellation must be returned
without revoking original retirement owners, while genuine owner loss must
still fail. The independent read-only snapshot remains bounded at two seconds.

Public Linux Node admission remains closed at this cutoff. Complete installed
bundle verification, application host/WaitReady/Router-proof/durable-retirement
composition, restart recovery and the remaining requested graph/protection
families still need their own acceptance evidence.

## Language and generated-source contracts

The actual native Xray workflow reached a `go vet` error because deterministic
tests used stable `testing/synctest` while the module declares Go 1.24.13.
`80dace69` moves only the two exact test bodies into a Go 1.25-constrained file.
Untagged references keep both tests mandatory. All 36 package test groups
(79 named passes) ran under the pinned Go 1.26.3 race toolchain, and the exact
four-package workflow vet passed. Removing the declaration or excluding the
file reproduces the intended failure.

The whole-module gate also exposed production PF `WaitGroup.Go` usage.
`624c5fa2` preserves the pinned implementation's normal return, Goexit and
panic ordering through explicit Add/launch/Done. It passes the three unchanged
PF tests five times under race, focused vet and the old-API/excluded-test
controls. The preparation contract requires the generated mandatory anchor.

`0136b1aa` similarly preserves all ten socket ownership/account test bodies
while making their language and required inclusion explicit. Whole `mobiletor`
vet, ten parent groups (89 named race passes), both old-language and both
excluded-file controls, 22 preparation cases and a missing-generated-anchor
control pass.

`ec35da9d` preserves all journal test bodies while declaring the required
language and three original file selections. Whole `windowsprotection` vet
passed on Linux and for both Windows architectures with the native tag. Seven
recovery parents and 22 named cases passed three race runs; all 22 required
test definitions compiled into both Windows binaries. Eight controls rejected
old-language declarations, omitted tests and omitted native receipt anchors.
The Windows binaries were compiled without CGO and were not executed locally.
`6309c662` completes the separate client declaration/source-closure unit:
all original test bodies remain byte-identical, production module language is
still Go 1.24.13, and mandatory symbol anchors prevent silent exclusion.
Whole-repository Linux `go vet ./...`, both Windows native-controller vet
targets, 75 ordinary race parents with 336 named passes, four prospective ALL
parents with 26 named passes, and 25 version/omission/closure controls passed.
Both CGO-free Windows compilations contain all 85 required definitions; those
compilations are not native execution. The unchanged native defect selectors
remain mandatory. This closes the demonstrated language gate without claiming
current all-platform packaging or device acceptance.

### WireGuard source, encrypted traffic and ownership evidence

The original positive failed before any encrypted packet reached its owned
peer. The real endpoint attempted the saved 25-second keepalive during native
startup, when the lower object correctly denied an unactivated owner. Its
later five-second handshake retry came after selected-DNS proof cancellation.
The corrected owner follows the existing Router design: after the original
authenticated factory completes and proves its deny baseline, only the sealed
Linux WG lower tuple may open its connected UDP socket. Ordered native stages,
exact manager/source identity, revocation and joined cleanup remain required.
`Current()` still requires full activation for TUN, DNS/exit proof and
measurement. No timeout, keepalive, peer identity or proof check was weakened.

### Hysteria2 source, real traffic and kernel evidence

The transport repairs address two separately reproduced failures. A final
native Read returned the complete TLS bytes with a wrapped EOF, preventing the
normal TLS/HTTP reader from recognizing completion. A normal remote code-zero
STOP_SENDING also made the first stream Close return an untyped error. The
client now preserves only literal EOF from the two actual stream reads and
maps only the same stream's typed remote code-zero close to the ordinary
closed-connection result. Protocol framing/authentication errors, nonzero or
local resets, the original reset cause, one Close, blocked-reader/writer join
and the shared QUIC connection remain protected. Temporary diagnostic overlays
were excluded from the published source and final native preparation.

### Measurement distinction retained

The required durable Router benchmark in `cmd/client/extras.go` uses 50–200
TCP-handshake attempts and stores the actual successful count, failures and
robust statistics. The existing quick live Fastest selector in
`cmd/client/telemetry.go` uses 1–10 samples (default five), selects without
connecting and never overwrites those durable fields. The earlier blanket
statement that every five-sample Fastest call needs conversion conflated these
two operations. Keep their labels and records distinct; quick measurements do
not satisfy the durable fifty-sample requirement. External comparison uses
its own routed HTTPS statistic, and neither statistic replaces the separate
two-probe Local/Server formula recorded below.

### Latest integration and validation boundaries — through f22d5a32

Complete saved benchmark eligibility and via-entry fifty-sample comparison are
now published across the desktop and mobile source paths. Samples remain routed
TCP response measurements; they are not relabeled as ICMP. Failed, incomplete,
stale or cancelled candidates never receive a winning zero. The saved source,
entry, network generation, original request and replacement-owner checks remain
part of acceptance. Platform execution is qualified individually above.

The normally prepared, pinned Linux AMD64 native CLI was independently built
from committed `187d57cd`. `TestViaEntryPinnedNativeUpstreamResponseAndCancellation`
executed all fifty real samples against a TCP peer that delayed each response
by 75 ms, rejected a refused and an uncaptured destination, and joined an entered
blocked-handshake cancellation with native child/socket cleanup. The case passed
in 5.03 s and its race package in 6.057 s, with no skip. The actual CLI SHA-256
was `79b91a30d6ab444c74e2b31aa7f402e24ff847fc9b72bce1a7f38d9429579a02`;
its normal runtime receipt was verified before and after execution. This closes
that local CLI gate, not another platform's packaged or physical acceptance.

Darwin HY2 layers now preserve the captured outer transport as the sole physical
authority, the private inner HY2 destination, independent credentials, selected
DNS, IPv6/LAN, MTU and original source. Actual wrong outer/inner keys and wrong
whitening must fail without DNS or public-exit proof. The negative native fixture
observes the original PF reference, baseline namespace, journal and complete
utun inventory after joined failed-Connect cleanup, before any repair action.
The PF query is read-only; it cannot make its own absence assertion pass by
clearing state. Successful Disconnect receives the same independent check.

The Windows TCP change addresses the source descriptor duplicated after Bind;
it does not add a `WSAEINVAL` retry, accept a failed Connect or widen a deadline.
The separate SOCKS and journal fixture corrections preserve their original
negative assertions. A joined local socket/WFP receipt is distinguished from
whether the remote peer observed a terminal TCP delivery. Native execution of
these latest source changes remains required.

authenticated TCP control and exact negotiated numeric UDP relay. A relay does
not become a global permission for other operations. Original credentials,
selected DNS, MTU, protection, original/derived source identity, measurement
operation and Router restoration remain captured. Server/Compare, predecessors,
Start Layers and unsupported platform combinations retain their requirements.

resolver/exit, invalid relays, control EOF, cancellation and independent owners.

grants disappear immediately after a successful DNS query. The pinned DNS
transport retains that original association until reset or close. A correction
that proves the retained pair and explicitly joins its original control is
published in `838dbb4c`. A subsequent `f9bf9d37` native run also exposed a
separate other-private-relay refusal-observation failure. Its provider discarded
the terminal read error, so the actual terminal TCP outcome is not established;
`5910543a` now requires that captured-phase/native-grant evidence; its native
rerun remains required.

`60816f3d` closes the private-relay transport gap: the same selected private
control address can own one exact negotiated UDP relay even with Home LAN Off.
The exception changes no shared destination or LAN prefix. Actual TCP identity,
grant sequence, expiry and joined child retirement are independently checked.
`4a153b89` extends control lifetime ownership to public and cross-family replies
while retaining ordinary destination permission for those endpoints. A valid
numeric public relay need not use the TCP control endpoint's address. Generic
Off execution retains its independent gate.

### Linux SOCKS guardian ownership

`cea693a0` independently verifies the original TCP kernel descriptor, creator
UID, cookie/inode, bound interface, exact peer, established TCP state and live
nft element. A canonical UDP marker names the captured control and sequence.
The UDP kernel timeout is conservatively bounded by the observed TCP expiry
and the remaining original two-second installation budget. Parent retirement
refuses while its child descriptor remains owned. Original static permissions,
Home LAN policy and public cross-family binding remain separate.

The actual namespace tests transfer private IPv4, private IPv6 and public
cross-family bytes through an independent peer, then exercise wrong sequence,
binding, missing native permit, half-closed TCP, direct UDP bypass, premature
parent retirement and association reuse. Three compiled defects remove native
permit proof, established-state proof and joined retirement respectively; each
fails its intended assertion. The half-close peer deliberately remains open so
another tuple error cannot hide a missing TCP-state check. These are native
guardian proofs. `76938d4d` adds the complete retained application's
running-inventory projection: exact selected TCP controls, native parent/child
markers, bounded expiry, ordinary Home LAN semantics and independent interface
bindings. All six retained native groups and thirteen NodeRunning leaves passed,
including private IPv4 and public cross-family associations. Physical-device
acceptance remains separate.

The previous single-process aggregate reached its two-minute test deadline
after earlier boundaries passed. The runner now requires three disjoint native
groups with the same per-process bounds, complete verdict inventory and actual
namespace cleanup. No production deadline or ownership test was removed.

### Protected Windows WireGuard and AmneziaWG

The same retained direct Local, Start Layer Off, On-connect/Always host now
admits WireGuard and both AWG variants through the public application path.
The generated endpoint can acquire only its compiled lower tuples after native
deny-baseline/admission initialization. That eager socket phase does not grant
proof, TUN or measurement readiness. Original keys, peer, PSK, AWG parameters,
selected DNS, derived measurement identity and protection remain captured.

Actual generated Linux execution passed all forty-seven encrypted proof, MTU,
cancellation, exact-fifty-sample and negative verdicts. Application race tests
passed both policies and fourteen original/restoration directions, including
Router-to-packet-to-Router and the reverse for all three packet variants.
Credential/resolver/parameter substitutions preserve the original live owner.
All six generated Windows component and both full application builds passed.

At that packet-protocol unit the Node runner preserved 109 roots and 326 verdicts in eight groups. The
external Box runner compiles one image, executes nineteen bounded groups and
requires 136 unique verdicts. All original transports and generic latency/
retirement cases remain selected. The real child/wrapper output repeats its
aggregate parent PASS, so only the unique required child verdicts supply that
integration evidence. No production or per-operation deadline was increased.

### Retained macOS application session

The actual privileged bootstrap now captures one native parent/session. It
retains the original controller credentials, supervisor peer, installation and
process locks, protected directory/image descriptors and controller identity.
Changed image, peer, controller or session invalidates the captured lifetime.
Dependents join before the controller can release borrowed locks. Failed
cleanup remains attached for retry; cancellation preserves its original error
without retiring an otherwise valid shared session.

The new mandatory native fixture exercises the actual supervisor, repeated
session acquisition, application capture, image replacement, peer EOF/extra
byte/supervisor stop and dependent join before inherited lock release. Isolated
local race and cross-build evidence does not substitute for those Darwin runs.
`f9bf9d37` adds the retained child with fixed inherited descriptors, original
runtime/controller/catalog identities, authenticated control and a separate
native-cleanup acknowledgment. Both complete Darwin builds and the normally
generated package passed. The ordinary PF transition and public external host
were subsequently published in `049e77ba`; forced process exit is never native
firewall-retirement evidence.

The real `f9bf9d37` Intel captured-child case failed a generic metadata check.
Source inspection found that XNU reports socket readiness as mode bits.
`be682651` treats only fixed FD9 as that native socket type, preserving root
UID/GID and the independent original
peer/local-address checks. Every named file, directory, executable and lock
retains its strict filesystem permissions. The
[pinned XNU soo_stat implementation](https://github.com/apple-oss-distributions/xnu/blob/f6217f891ac0bb64f3d375211650a4c1ff8ca1ea/bsd/kern/sys_socket.c)
documents that distinction. The later `be682651` native parent progresses to
the inherited child, which still reports an ownership mismatch. The failing
object is not established by that generic message; `7c712e3d` adds precise
metadata diagnostics without changing the checks.

### macOS installation and PF ownership

The first/legacy installer previously attempted a bare host inventory, which
rejected an unrelated unlinked executable without comparing it to product
ownership. Admission now captures the complete current protected installation
and verified incoming stage. An ephemeral legacy observation never invents a
historical receipt. Both linked renamed and unlinked copies are compared using
the existing kernel image identity, with process/exec/path fences. Unknown
identity, incomplete present code and changed recorded generations still fail.

The incoming Go bootstrap was found to remain alive during that image scan.
The final shipping fix exec-replaces it with the already validated interpreter;
the fixed Python supervisor runs the captured installer in the same PID and
owns cleanup of that exact private directory. Same-PID execution, real argument
failure status, streams, failed exec, replaced-directory refusal and cleanup
were tested. No PID, signer or unrelated-process exception was introduced.
[The ownership boundary](MACOS-INSTALLER-LIVE-IMAGE.md) records what an erased,
unregistered historical image cannot establish.

The PF change addresses an observed serial tail in Intel macOS readback.
Independent direct/recursive filter and NAT queries share at most four actual
native command slots, including nested groups. Slots are held through command
join; waiting parents do not hold one. Earlier nonempty owners, stateful or
unknown filters and NAT/RDR/BINAT remain refusals. The original two-second
grant deadline, complete joins and prohibition on changing foreign rules remain.

## Requirements still open

The existing generic Darwin external runtime is real. Its newer retained direct
Local SS/HTTP/HTTPS/Hysteria2 host, baseline transition and authenticated child
are published for On-connect/Always. HY2 AES/AES+XOR is now published in
`f22d5a32`, alongside mandatory real Retest/Cancel and encrypted refusal cases.
Complete sealed-bundle PF/utun execution remains required. Current retained
Darwin SOCKS5, WireGuard/AWG/OpenVPN, Router-host and predecessor integrations
remain source work; lower socket support or a generic runtime alone does not
close those shipping paths. A failed external-Connect lifecycle regression has
also been reproduced through the actual public handlers and is outside this
source cutoff until its focused correction is published.

Linux SOCKS retained running-inventory integration was already published and
natively tested in `76938d4d`; it is not a missing feature. Linux HY2 layer-host
integration and the expanded installed TUN gate are now published in `14dc92e3`
and `eda48633`; the complete expanded native gate remains required. Windows HY2
layers, SOCKS and packet families have published retained integration and real
encrypted reference coverage, with their exact native WFP boundaries described
above. The descriptor and fixture repairs need actual native reruns.
Broader retained families, additional Start Layer compositions, predecessors,
multihop and Server/Compare remain accountable; a safe refusal does not close
those requirements. The full original platform and graph ledger remains the
authority rather than this navigation list.

Relevant native reruns and complete exact-SHA package/image/compose publication
remain open. A fresh release API read still identifies the latest release as the
twelve-asset [745b3e41 prerelease](https://github.com/Eabusham2/router-vpn/releases/tag/router-vpn-sha-745b3e41e5a78d734391976af9b7cd0637660a0b).
The original all-platform graphs, Methods/recovery, signing, physical/off-LAN
network/visual/accessibility acceptance, private providers, and deliberately
authorized ASUS/Portainer deployment remain separately accountable. No private
router, AdGuard, forwarding or deployment configuration was changed.
